rationale: Cap10-to30 changed actual gradients but did not rescue32-step response/policy.
Prior frozen actor window update reduced completion; reduce learning rate/updates and add an unchanged live-parent control.
Refresh labels from current B checkpoint and supervise4-step response; compare both weights on5080, replicate .05 vsB on3090.

3090.basis: 26+60 cells at observed261.7sec, ten2000-iteration continuations, shorter-response cost no greater than observed H32 estimate; no guarantee.

5080.basis: 240 cells at observed96.1sec plus15 short2000-iteration continuations and20 conservative100-update windows.

original_D: Strict8/32 gate0.5 retained in separate calibration artifact; prior failures not changed.

empirical_D.risk: maximum relative prefix RMSE over first 32 steps
empirical_D.selection: lower half of sample-sufficient, finite-risk bins (floor), ties broken by bin id; all others short
empirical_D.interpretation: Empirical cal-risk ranking, NOT validated/certified horizons or original paper D. Original validation booleans remain truthful.
empirical_D.degenerate: Run named empirical branches using the actual constant horizon; mark nonidentifiable, no D mechanism claim.

decision_rules.primary_C: C_h4_w05 minus B_refresh within each GPU, five nonreference scenarios averaged per seed, all five paired seeds. Also report C_h4_w01 on 5080.
decision_rules.primary_D_emp: D_emp minus C_perm_emp and fixed16/fixed32 on 5080, and change from identical parent live actor. All seeds/conditions; degenerate mapping is not evidence for state selection.
decision_rules.calibration: Preserve strict 8/32 relative0.5 results. Empirical16/32 ranking is a distinct exploratory protocol, never overwrite or claim strict D success.
decision_rules.stop: Nine active hours with two-minute reserve, low disk, nonfinite/integrity error, interrupted process. No selecting favorable seeds, early success pruning or fabricated complete matrices.
decision_rules.cross_device: Separate replications; never pool raw response magnitudes or treat hardware differences as intervention effects.
decision_rules.completion: Complete means every declared cell and response/calibration/paired-run check exists; otherwise enumerate missing cells.

scope_limit: C/D development campaign; not a complete rerun of original seven paper groups, hardware or unseen-motion tests.
launch_5080: Package prepared; user must launch on remote5080, no remote access exercised.
